articles.title: All Five 'Letters' of DNA Found in an Ancient Asteroid
articles.summary: All five nucleobases, the molecular "letters" of DNA and RNA, have been found in samples from the asteroid Ryugu.

articles.title: Scientists Finally Recreate a 1,600-Year-Old Color-Changing Cup
articles.summary: Scientists at the University of Sheffield have finally recreated the Lycurgus Cup's colour-changing Roman glass.

articles.title: An Ancient Ape Fossil in Egypt Could Rewrite Our Family Tree
articles.summary: A 17- to 18-million-year-old ape fossil found in Egypt, Masripithecus moghraensis, is the first definitive fossil ape from North Africa.
